text:
lina_cs: Heads up — ACME (acct acme-42) says Feb invoice is ~300k tokens lower than dashboard. Dashboard export shows 1,245,678 tokens; invoice line items show 945,612. They want a root cause + credit.

sam_billing: Ack. Can you paste the invoice lines + dashboard export? I'll start a quick diff.

lina_cs: Pasting quick snippets below. Invoice 'summarized_usage' tokens = 945,612. Dashboard per-request export (raw_tokens sum) = 1,245,678. Customer notes many streaming completions in Feb. Tagging @raj_ops and @emily_fin.

--- invoice_lines.csv snippet ---
org_id,month,line_item_type,tokens
acme-42,2026-02,summarized_usage,945612

--- dashboard_export.csv snippet (sample rows) ---
request_id,ts,endpoint,raw_tokens
req_01,2026-02-03T12:01:02Z,completions.stream,120
req_02,2026-02-03T12:01:05Z,completions.stream,300
... total_raw_tokens,1245678

raj_ops: Looking. Two quick hypotheses: 1) end-of-month summarization job applied an avg_tokens_per_call that wasn't properly weighted by call_count; 2) ingest sampling flag was enabled during a high-throughput window and the sampling multiplier was applied to billing table incorrectly. Can you run these two queries to confirm?

sam_billing: Ran quick diff, results below.
```sql
select sum(raw_tokens) from request_logs where org_id='acme-42' and ts >= '2026-02-01' and ts < '2026-03-01';
-- returns 1245678

select tokens from summarized_usage where org_id='acme-42' and month='2026-02';
-- returns 945612
```

raj_ops: Found the culprit. The summarized_usage aggregation used avg_tokens_per_call sampled over a 24h window and then multiplied by distinct_call_count without weighting by actual call_counts per bucket. For streaming requests we also had partial-chunk dedup logic that reduced avg_tokens_per_call. Integer truncation + missing weighting produced ~24% undercount. Patch PR: github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/3842. Re-running aggregation job for Feb now (recompute summarized_usage).

metering-bot: Incident created: MTR-2026-218 — "Summarized usage weighting bug" — assigned to @raj_ops. ETA for aggregation re-run: ~2h. Patch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/3842

emily_fin: If re-run increases billed tokens, we'll issue a credit for the discrepancy and update the invoice. Please capture exact delta and cost calc.

raj_ops: Re-run complete. summarized_usage tokens now 1,245,670 (very close to dashboard). Delta = +300,058 tokens. Logging repro steps and commit in the incident.

sam_billing: Queuing invoice adjustment for acme-42. Provisional credit calc (approx): 300,058 tokens * $0.02 per 1k = ~$6.00. Will generate formal credit memo after finance sign-off.

emily_fin: Approved provisional credit. Please prepare credit memo with reason: "metering ingestion aggregation bug; summarized_usage undercount" and draft customer message. I'll sign-off on final amount.

lina_cs: Thanks team — I'll update ACME support thread with root cause explanation, incident link, and ETA for updated invoice + credit memo. :thumbsup:
